description: Starts immediately unless the recruited crowd is wrong (more than 1 in 5 not the requested audience); the result includes the audience summary, examples and fit. Only a wrong crowd returns audience_review: show the warning, then use review_id, confirm_audience and audience_fit_acknowledged to continue, or audience_correction to recruit again. Show a web page to simulated people and hear how they react: who would stay, who would leave, and why. Each person scrolls the page and says what confused them, what they doubted and what would change their mind. Use it after you build or change a landing, pricing or signup page, then fix what they raised and test again. Needs a public URL (for localhost, open a tunnel first; see the server instructions). Returns each person's action, thoughts and objections, and the counts. With a key, the result ends with a link to the full report in the Mimiq app.

audience.description: Who the simulated people should be, in plain words, e.g. "startup founders in SF" or "parents shopping for kids toys". If omitted, Mimiq picks the likely audience from the content.

audience_correction.description: Not quite? Change who and rerun: use with review_id. Recruits a new crowd under the existing credit rules; starts unless the new crowd is wrong, otherwise returns a new review.

audience_fit_acknowledged.description: Set only after telling the user about an audience-fit warning and they choose to continue.

confirm_audience.description: Start with the reviewed people after showing them to the user.

count.description: How many simulated people (default 10, max 50). Each person uses one credit.

goal.description: What the page should get people to do, e.g. "sign up for the waitlist".

review_id.description: The review_id from a low-fit review or completed/running result. Bound to this URL and test kind.

url.description: The page to test. Must be publicly reachable. For localhost, open a cloudflared tunnel and pass the tunnel URL.

name: mimiq.test_page
title: Test a page
